title: 2段式駐輪ラック
description: 駅前や集合住宅の駐輪場に設置する、上下2段の駐輪ラックです。亜鉛めっきの柱と梁、下段の車輪レール4本と前輪クランプ、上段の引出し式トレー3本と昇降補助ダンパー、吊り材と台車を造形しています。上段は収納位置で固定され、引出し・昇降の動作、自転車、番号札は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.600 × 2.150 × 1.825 m、4,260三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A two-tier bicycle rack for station and apartment bicycle parking. It models galvanized posts and beams, four lower wheel channels with front-wheel clamps, three upper pull-out trays with lift-assist struts, hangers and carriages. Upper trays are fixed in their stowed position; pull-out and lift motion, bicycles and number plates are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.600 × 2.150 × 1.825 m; 4,260 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
